# Documentation Templates

This folder contains reusable templates for documenting milestones in the
Safety-Critical In-Cabin Driver Monitoring project.

## Available Templates

| Template | Purpose |
|-----------|---------|
| implementation_template.md | Engineering implementation documentation |
| validation_template.md | Validation report |

## Workflow

1. Copy the required template.
2. Rename the file according to the documentation standard.
3. Complete every section.
4. Store implementation documents inside `docs/implementation/`.
5. Store validation documents inside `docs/validation/`.

## Goal

Every milestone should be understandable, reproducible and reviewable by another Robotics Vision / Perception Engineer.
